project_info.theme: Cute lifestyle collage promoting the Cocoon tote bag as a campaign reward
project_info.color_palette: Grass Green, Soft Pink, Sky Blue, Red Gingham, Cream White, Pastel Lime

main_subject.detail: A playful picnic collage featuring two young people on a red-and-white checkered blanket in a park, centered around a pale green tote bag printed 'Cocoon VIỆT NAM', with polaroid-style inset photos and the headline 'TÚI XINH COCOON'.
main_subject.style: Scrapbook lifestyle editorial, youthful picnic aesthetic, social collage with candid photography and framed insert snapshots

composition_elements.text: Visible text includes 'TÚI XINH COCOON', side text '2026' and '#THUHOIVOCHAI' on the upper inset frame, and 'the COCOON ORIGINAL VIETNAM' on the lower inset bag photo.
items: Top Left: A girl in a cream cap and pink shirt holding a compact camera while sitting on the picnic blanket.
Top Right: Large headline 'TÚI XINH COCOON' and a white framed inset photo showing hands pointing at the tote bag during the picnic.
Bottom Left: A large pale green tote bag printed 'Cocoon VIỆT NAM' dominating the foreground, plus a smaller polaroid-style inset bag photo over greenery.
Bottom Right: A boy in a blue cap lying on the blanket, with an orange fruit nearby and open park grass around the blanket.
Center/Background: Sunny green lawn, red-and-white gingham picnic blanket, and pastel picnic props creating a cheerful collage layout.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Sunny park highlights, soft candid shadows, scrapbook warmth, youthful casual mood

technical_specs.render_style: High fidelity lifestyle collage photography with framed overlay inserts

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality advertising poster for a cute lifestyle collage promoting a Cocoon tote bag. Centerpiece is a sunny park picnic scene with two young people on a red-and-white gingham blanket and a large pale green tote bag printed 'Cocoon VIỆT NAM' in the foreground. Background is green lawn under bright daylight. Surrounding elements: headline 'TÚI XINH COCOON', a girl holding a compact camera, a boy lying on the blanket, an orange fruit, and two polaroid-style inset images featuring the tote bag, including one with side text '2026' and '#THUHOIVOCHAI'. Keep the scrapbook collage framing and casual youthful picnic mood. Technical style: high fidelity lifestyle collage photography with framed overlay inserts, bright natural daylight, sunny park highlights and soft candid shadows, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped
